counter_notes: commits is window-only; commits_total is cumulative.
q/j removed/created/retired/introduced count events, while location counts are census levels; do not add event counters to census levels.
busy_seconds, join_call_seconds, and tracked_collective_call_seconds are overlapping diagnostic scopes, not additive wall time.
geometry_excess_hist is a disjoint excess-bin histogram and sums to geometry_bad; geometry_authority_types can overlap across bins and are not expected to sum to geometry_bad.
short09/short05 shares are weighted by the per-census bad_union; near-feature counts are reported independently for q and J, with unknown feature counts separate.

Surface/interior labels follow physical-face classification; interior can touch constrained boundary vertices. Fixed-drift samples are16 distinct global points reported on all6ranks, not96 distinct points.
